<h1 id="2026--10-做题记录">2026 · 10 做题记录</h1>
<h1 id="1005">1005</h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/CF1837F" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CF 1837F</a></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>tag</strong> : <strong>反悔贪心</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>二分转判定</li>
<li>枚举分界线</li>
<li>扫描线</li>
<li>反悔贪心 pre[i] + suf[i] &gt;= k</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/CF1367D" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CF 1367D</a></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>tag : 构造 性质 调整法</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>
<p><span class="math inline">\(b[i] = 0\)</span> 一定是最大字符</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>每次更新 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span> 数组</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/CF1906B" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CF 1906B</a></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>tag : 构造 性质 前缀异或和 模型转化</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>看到操作想到差分，进而想到前缀异或和</li>
<li>通过模拟，发现性质，得到转化</li>
<li>即，将原问题转化为比较两个串前缀异或和中 1 的个数</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/CF1519E" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CF 1519E</a></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>tag : 构造 建图优化 点边对偶</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>从 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2)\)</span> 连点建图通过<strong>点边对偶</strong>转化成：将每个斜率作为节点建图 <span class="math inline">\(=&gt;\)</span> <span class="math inline">\(O(n)\)</span></li>
<li>每次操作即被转化成对每个点的相邻两条边操作，即 ：<strong>无向图的邻边匹配问题</strong></li>
<li>然后通过对树边和非树边的讨论，分别对每个连通块求解，得到构造</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/CF977E" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CF 977E</a></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>tag : 图论 连通块 度数 细节警示</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>细节注意：<span class="math inline">\(dfs\)</span> 遍历连通块时不能中途 <span class="math inline">\(return\)</span>，否则会漏掉未访问的顶点</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h1 id="1006">1006</h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://oj.xinxingshe.cn:444/d/xxs/p/NOIP260305" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">留下峰值</a></p>
<ul>
<li>细节注意：更新右端点时忘记更新最大值 （导致模拟赛 T1 挂分 100 -&gt; 40）</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h1 id="1008">1008</h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p>上午</p>
<ul>
<li>
<blockquote>
<p>和高二一起打 <span class="math inline">\(ARC111\)</span>，爆 0 了，对思维题不太适应</p>
</blockquote>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/AT_arc111_a" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">ARC111A Simple Math 2</a></p>
<ul>
<li>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>tag : 数学</strong></p>
</blockquote>
</li>
<li>
<p>没有想到把模数提进来：</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>$ \left\lfloor \frac{10^N \bmod M^2}{M} \right\rfloor $</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/AT_arc111_b" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">ARC111B Reversible Cards</a></p>
<ul>
<li>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>tag : 图伦 建模转化</strong></p>
</blockquote>
</li>
<li>
<p>建图正确，但是没有分别讨论环和树</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/AT_arc111_c" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">ARC111C Too Heavy</a></p>
<ul>
<li>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>tag : 贪心 置换</strong></p>
</blockquote>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/AT_arc111_d" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">ARC111D Orientation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>tag : 构造 图论</strong></p>
</blockquote>
</li>
<li>
<p>若 <span class="math inline">\(u \to v\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(R(v) \subseteq R(u)\)</span>，故 <span class="math inline">\(c_u \ge c_v\)</span>。因此 <span class="math inline">\(c_u &gt; c_v\)</span> 定向 <span class="math inline">\(u \to v\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(c_u &lt; c_v\)</span> 定向 <span class="math inline">\(v \to u\)</span>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>若 <span class="math inline">\(c_u = c_v\)</span>，则必须 <span class="math inline">\(R(u)=R(v)\)</span>，即 <span class="math inline">\(u,v\)</span> 强连通。相同 <span class="math inline">\(c\)</span> 的连通块必须定向为强连通图。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>题目保证有解 <span class="math inline">\(\Rightarrow\)</span> 这些连通块无桥。DFS 定向：树边父 <span class="math inline">\(\to\)</span> 子，非树边子孙 <span class="math inline">\(\to\)</span> 祖先，即强连通。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>实现：不同 <span class="math inline">\(c\)</span> 直接定向；相同 <span class="math inline">\(c\)</span> 的边 DFS，未访问则 <span class="math inline">\(u \to v\)</span> 并递归，已访问则 <span class="math inline">\(u \to v\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 是祖先）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>晚上</p>
<ul>
<li>
<blockquote>
<p>打比赛 ：<a href="https://nsoj.top/c/40" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CSES</a> (<strong>ACM</strong> 赛制)</p>
</blockquote>
</li>
<li>
<p>感觉时间不太够，只写完前 5 个题；</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>赛后发现 T6 是个状压 DP，比较简单；</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>T7 <a href="https://vjudge.net/problem/CSES-1737" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Range Queries and Copies_CSES - 1737</a> 学长说要用<strong>主席树</strong>，不太会，写了一个<strong>离线建版本树 + DFS + 回滚数据结构</strong> AC了</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h1 id="1009">1009</h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/CF1473E" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CF1473E Minimum Path</a></p>
<ul>
<li>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>tag : 分层图 最短路</strong></p>
</blockquote>
</li>
<li>
<p>模型转化：把原式拆成正常边权和后，转化为在分层图上恰好选一条边免费、一条边双倍的最短路。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>多个状态转移</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/CF1922F" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CF1922F Replace on Segment</a></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>误以为“区间不含颜色 c”可以用“区间全变成某个 d ≠ c”替代，漏掉了“部分刷色、整体不含”这一中间状态</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>正确的状态是同时维护&nbsp;<span class="math inline">\(f[l][r][c]\)</span>（区间全变成&nbsp;<span class="math inline">\(c\)</span>）和&nbsp;<span class="math inline">\(g[l][r][c]\)</span>（区间不含&nbsp;<span class="math inline">\(c\)</span>）两个状态</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
